conventions.notes: Task prompts name only an item ID. Items live in the case system: an opaque store (.cases/store.dat) that only tools/case reads. The README mentions only the case system.
The lookup output lists the files to change under 'Files:' (the `files` field with --json). Registry items list the CSV and the module that reads it, never the generated file.

Test files import tools/testing/fixtures.mjs, which throws unless the fixtures were preloaded by `npm run check` (--import ./tools/testing/setup.mjs), so any generic runner fails. The working command is declared in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: the test fixtures are not loaded, this suite runs through npm run check

conventions.notes: Lookups read src/generated/registry.mjs, generated from registry/*.csv. Editing a CSV requires npm run codegen; npm run check and the hidden checks fail on stale output.
conventions.signature: error: src/generated/registry.mjs is out of date with registry/*.csv, run npm run codegen
